0.name: TEXT_JOBDEFMCH_00296_PELDERAIN_000_000
0.description: Welcome to the Skysteel Manufactory, where miracles are born from aether, metal, an' imagination!

1.name: TEXT_JOBDEFMCH_00296_PELDERAIN_000_001
1.description: <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, was it? If you've aught to ask, then I'm here to answer!

4.name: TEXT_JOBDEFMCH_00296_PELDERAIN_A1_000_002
4.description: What kind of place is this?

7.name: TEXT_JOBDEFMCH_00296_PELDERAIN_000_010
7.description: The name's Pelderain. As a manufactory employee, I help build the parts what are needed for everythin' from dragon-slayin' weapons to airships.

8.name: TEXT_JOBDEFMCH_00296_PELDERAIN_000_011
8.description: Afore I started workin' here, I was beggin' for scraps, but this place gave me a trade an' a steady wage. I've learned all about makin' an' fixin' all sorts of machinery, an' lately we've been gettin' machinist lessons.

9.name: TEXT_JOBDEFMCH_00296_PELDERAIN_000_012
9.description: I'd likely be freezin' in an alley somewhere if it weren't for Lord Stephanivien invitin' me in from the cold...

10.name: TEXT_JOBDEFMCH_00296_PELDERAIN_000_020
10.description: The manufactory here is run by House Haillenarte. From cannons to ballistas, we develop an' manufacture a range of weapons what are made for slayin' dragon invaders.

11.name: TEXT_JOBDEFMCH_00296_PELDERAIN_000_021
11.description: We also dabble in machinistry─that's a technology what combines Master Garlond's magitek with traditional aetherology. All our machinist firearms are built on its principles.

12.name: TEXT_JOBDEFMCH_00296_PELDERAIN_000_022
12.description: Of course, it's Lord Stephanivien as comes up with the designs. The bloke's a bloody genius...even if he is a bit odd.

13.name: TEXT_JOBDEFMCH_00296_PELDERAIN_000_023
13.description: He ain't like any noble I've ever met. As long as you've got a desire to learn the machinist trade, he's as happy to recruit the poorest Brume rat as he is the richest highborn.

14.name: TEXT_JOBDEFMCH_00296_PELDERAIN_000_024
14.description: An' it don't matter if you've never held a firearm in your life. We've got a bloke from Limsa Lominsa who's paid to teach you the basics of marksmanship.

15.name: TEXT_JOBDEFMCH_00296_PELDERAIN_000_030
15.description: Basically, a machinist is someone what wields a firearm. But it's the aetherotransformer worn at <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468697303> waist what makes <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468696D03> different from other marksmen. This machine converts the aether found within a person's body into lightnin'-aspected energy, which then powers the machinist's arsenal of specialized devices an' techniques. Or so I'm told.

16.name: TEXT_JOBDEFMCH_00296_PELDERAIN_000_031
16.description: With the right trainin' an' technology, even a lowborn Brume rat like me can add more punch to the battlefield than a fully armored knight.

17.name: TEXT_JOBDEFMCH_00296_PELDERAIN_000_032
17.description: Now, we machinists still ain't gained much respect or attention amongst the tradition-bound nobles of Ishgard, but, as his lordship is so fond of sayin', the day will soon come when our true worth is recognized.

18.name: TEXT_JOBDEFMCH_00296_PELDERAIN_000_040
18.description: Well, now, if it ain't the manufactory's top machinist! What can I do for you, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>?

19.name: TEXT_JOBDEFMCH_00296_PELDERAIN_000_041
19.description: <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! The lads an' I still ain't stopped talkin' about that fight with Veri Selen! If there's aught I can do for you, you need only ask!

20.name: TEXT_JOBDEFMCH_00296_PELDERAIN_000_130
20.description: I heard from his lordship that you're off teachin' the watch how to handle a firearm. Me an' the lads wish we'd had you for our instructor...

21.name: TEXT_JOBDEFMCH_00296_PELDERAIN_000_140
21.description: Them Hounds have made a real name for themselves, ain't they? Not hard when they've got a machinist like you helpin' them out, though!

22.name: TEXT_JOBDEFMCH_00296_PELDERAIN_000_240
22.description: Bless the Fury, if it ain't the manufactory's top machinist! You're farin' well, I hope? For us lot, it's been trainin', trainin', an' more trainin'!

25.name: TEXT_JOBDEFMCH_00296_PELDERAIN_A2_000_002
25.description: What kind of place is this?

28.name: TEXT_JOBDEFMCH_00296_PELDERAIN_000_050
28.description: Well, the count's lookin' to us machinists as House Haillenarte's risin' stars, an' his lordship's buried himself arse-deep in new inventions.

29.name: TEXT_JOBDEFMCH_00296_PELDERAIN_000_051
29.description: He's been so busy sketchin' out designs an' the like, I don't think he's left the workshop in...well I've lost track of the days.

30.name: TEXT_JOBDEFMCH_00296_PELDERAIN_000_055
30.description: Well, after Rostnsthal left, he passed the torch of master of marksmanship to Joye.

31.name: TEXT_JOBDEFMCH_00296_PELDERAIN_000_056
31.description: The thing is, though, when Joye takes up her firearm, she's even more foul-mouthed than he was.

32.name: TEXT_JOBDEFMCH_00296_PELDERAIN_000_057
32.description: Between her swearin' an' the initiates' wailin', I can hardly concentrate on me bloody work...

33.name: TEXT_JOBDEFMCH_00296_PELDERAIN_000_150
33.description: We just had ourselves a joint trainin' session with the Hounds. Between you and Rostnsthal, it seems they've learned enough trigger work to meet even Joye's high standards.

34.name: TEXT_JOBDEFMCH_00296_PELDERAIN_000_151
34.description: You know, them Hounds seem to have a presence about them─an <hex:021A020203>authority<hex:021A020103>, you could call it. I s'pose that's the difference betwixt a group of engineers an' a proper squad o' soldiers.

35.name: TEXT_JOBDEFMCH_00296_PELDERAIN_000_152
35.description: As a bloke from the same lowborn stock, it makes me feel safe─an' more'n a little bit proud─to have them protectin' our home!

36.name: TEXT_JOBDEFMCH_00296_PELDERAIN_000_250
36.description: Joye an' Hilda are thick as thieves these days. You might think they'd be wanderin' the markets lookin' at dresses, but not them two lasses.

37.name: TEXT_JOBDEFMCH_00296_PELDERAIN_000_251
37.description: I hear they've been off trainin' in secret, workin' on new machinist moves. You ask me, they was strong enough already.

38.name: TEXT_JOBDEFMCH_00296_PELDERAIN_000_252
38.description: Now the rest of us have to train twice as hard if we're to stay on top of the latest techniques!

39.name: TEXT_JOBDEFMCH_00296_PELDERAIN_000_350
39.description: His lordship tells me you've graduated from the savior of Skysteel to the savior of the whole damn world! I'd expect naught less from our top machinist, of course.

40.name: TEXT_JOBDEFMCH_00296_PELDERAIN_000_351
40.description: As for the rest of us, they've been keepin' us busy with deployments to the Empire, and takin' apart whatever warmachina they've salvaged from the field. You should see his lordship tinkerin' with one of them things─he's like a lad with a new toy.

41.name: TEXT_JOBDEFMCH_00296_PELDERAIN_000_352
41.description: Otherwise, we've been keepin' up our trainin' with the Hounds. Joye teaches them how to shoot, and we help them out with their investigations. Never a dull moment, I can tell you that much.

45.name: TEXT_JOBDEFMCH_00296_PELDERAIN_000_060
45.description: As you well know, the manufactory here is run by House Haillenarte. From cannons to ballistas, we develop an' manufacture a range of weapons what are made for slayin' dragon invaders.

46.description: We also dabble in machinistry─that's a technology what combines Master Garlond's magitek with traditional aetherology. All our machinist firearms are built on its principles.

47.name: TEXT_JOBDEFMCH_00296_PELDERAIN_000_062
47.description: Of course, it's Lord Stephanivien as comes up with the designs. The bloke's a bloody genius...even if he is a bit odd.

48.name: TEXT_JOBDEFMCH_00296_PELDERAIN_000_063
48.description: He ain't like any noble I've ever met. As long as you've got a desire to learn the machinist trade, he's as happy to recruit the poorest Brume rat as he is the richest highborn.

49.name: TEXT_JOBDEFMCH_00296_PELDERAIN_000_064
49.description: As his lordship puts it, “With the trainin' of a machinist, an' the flexibility of a firearm, a skilled commoner can stand on equal footing with the mightiest knight.”

50.name: TEXT_JOBDEFMCH_00296_PELDERAIN_000_065
50.description: Of course, givin' a lowborn bloke like me a voice equal to a privileged noble ain't as easy as slappin' a carbine in me hand. But as far as grantin' us commonfolk a bit of independence goes, it's a step in the right direction.

51.name: TEXT_JOBDEFMCH_00296_PELDERAIN_000_110
51.description: As you well know, the manufactory here is run by House Haillenarte. From cannons to ballistas, we develop an' manufacture a range of weapons what are made for slayin' dragon invaders.

52.name: TEXT_JOBDEFMCH_00296_PELDERAIN_000_111
52.description: An' thanks to your efforts on behalf of the workshop, we've had more folk than ever clamorin' to take up the machinist trade.

53.name: TEXT_JOBDEFMCH_00296_PELDERAIN_000_070
53.description: Now why would the workshop's best machinist need to ask me that? Oh, I get it...you're testin' me. Well the jape's on you, 'cause I've learned me lines by heart.

54.name: TEXT_JOBDEFMCH_00296_PELDERAIN_000_071
54.description: Basically, a machinist is someone what wields a firearm. But it's the aetherotransformer worn at <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468697303> waist what makes <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468696D03> different from other marksmen. This machine converts the aether found within a person's body into lightnin'-aspected energy, which then powers the machinist's arsenal of specialized devices an' techniques.

55.name: TEXT_JOBDEFMCH_00296_PELDERAIN_000_072
55.description: With the right trainin' an' technology, even a lowborn Brume rat like me can add more punch to the battlefield than a fully armored knight.

56.name: TEXT_JOBDEFMCH_00296_PELDERAIN_000_073
56.description: The old guard are havin' trouble lettin' go of their tired old ideas of warfare, but there are some what are beginning to understand what we bring to the battlefield. Thanks to you, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, there'll soon be a day when no Ishgardian army'll be considered complete without a company of machinists!

57.name: TEXT_JOBDEFMCH_00296_PELDERAIN_000_120
57.description: Now why would the workshop's best machinist need to ask me that? Oh, I get it...you're testin' me. Well the jape's on you, 'cause I've learned me lines by heart.

58.name: TEXT_JOBDEFMCH_00296_PELDERAIN_000_121
58.description: Basically, a machinist is someone what wields a firearm. But it's the aetherotransformer worn at <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468697303> waist what makes <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468696D03> different from other marksmen. This machine converts the aether found within a person's body into lightnin'-aspected energy, which then powers the machinist's arsenal of specialized devices an' techniques.

59.name: TEXT_JOBDEFMCH_00296_PELDERAIN_000_122
59.description: With this kind of technology an' the right kind of trainin', you don't need to be a knight to handle them Dravanian beasts.

60.name: TEXT_JOBDEFMCH_00296_PELDERAIN_000_123
60.description: A lot of highborn folk in Ishgard still think of the knight as the master of the battlefield. Surprisingly, though, Lord Tedalgrinche has been true to his word, an' is working to see us machinists included in the city's defenses.
